Overview

Mysore is a city in Karnataka with a population of 1,100,000. The City of Palaces, known for its royal heritage, magnificent Mysore Palace, Dasara festival, and sandalwood and silk industries. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
